convention: Every field valid with integers 1 and floats 1.0, rendered by the shared emitter through tools/live_sample.h. utc is the stored microseconds times 1000 on the wire.

f35d73981ca65d9de587a4ec7988ccea19e71dce.note: Dictionary cores3-telemetry-v4. The digest does not cover the LIVE keys. Every build from ab02a26 (v6.9) through 95ef33c (v6.11) hashes telemetry_fields.inc to this digest and uses the same hardcoded LIVE list as e166978, only the source column was event_time_utc_ns instead of event_time_utc_us, and utc was nanoseconds on the wire in both.

builds.note: Reconstructed from source. Same key list and hardware behaviour as e166978, IMU die temperature as t and rh absent. Earlier builds in the range report v6.9 or v6.10 with the same keys. Not captured on hardware.

22291d3aab63365404394f30c1549fb18bde0699.note: Two released builds share this digest and both report firmware idf-cores3-parquet-v6.12, so a reader cannot tell them apart from the digest or the firmware string. Both send the IMU die temperature, under t in the first build and under imu_t in the second. ambient_temperature_c and relative_humidity_percent are always null on CoreS3, so rh never appears and t never carries ambient air on real hardware.

builds.note: Reconstructed from source. The list mapped imu_temperature_c to t whenever ambient_temperature_c was null, which is always on CoreS3. This records what real hardware sends, rh absent and the IMU as t, not the every field valid convention render, which would show ambient t and rh and skip the IMU. Not captured on hardware.

Reconstructed from the live_key switch in firmware/esp-idf-cores3/bringup/telemetry_contract.h at d2a840c, unchanged through 663ae40. t and rh are mapped but always null on CoreS3. Not captured on hardware.
